channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Lionel Messi | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Lionel Messi from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Manu Ginobili on Lionel Messi
item.description:
Interviewer to Manu Ginobili:

“A lot of press in Europe call you the Messi of basketball, but Messi told the press ‘No, I am the Manu of football’. What is your reaction to the best football player putting you above himself.”

Manu Ginobili on Lionel Messi, Sep 16, 2018. Source: reddit.

item.title: Dirk Nowitzki on LeBron James, Lionel Messi
item.description:
“Messi can hide sometimes and only needs one genius touch to look good. LeBron can never hide. Eyes are always on him. But he's just such a better athlete than anyone we've ever seen. He just makes the game look easy.”

Dirk Nowitzki on LeBron James, Lionel Messi, Mar 16, 2013. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Luol Deng on Lionel Messi
item.description:
“I have to go with Messi. Because what he's doing, he's about to, he's on pace to (become) the best ever.”

Luol Deng on Lionel Messi, Mar 16, 2013. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Kobe Bryant on Lionel Messi
item.description:
“It would be fun if I spent one week with Barcelona and Messi played one week with the Lakers,”

Kobe Bryant on Lionel Messi, Sep 22, 2012. Source: Goal.com.

item.title: Kobe Bryant on Lionel Messi
item.description:
“What the commercial will be like? Probably Messi will play football and I will play basketball...”

Kobe Bryant on Lionel Messi, Sep 22, 2012. Source: Goal.com.
